title: How Far Apart?
objective: The distance between two quantities/positions is itself a quantity that can be found and named — plants the seed for subtraction-as-distance.
studentQuestion: How far apart are these two numbers?
newIdea: Distance between two quantities as a nameable amount.

teaching.setup: Two numbers marked on the path from the previous lesson (e.g. 3 and 7).
teaching.see: How far do you have to travel from 3 to get to 7?
teaching.break: Count the steps along the path from one mark to the other.
teaching.build: Name the distance (4 steps) as its own quantity.
teaching.transform: The same gap, described as steps from 3 to 7 or steps from 7 back to 3 — same distance, different direction.

check.prompt: Count the steps the other direction (7 back to 3) — same distance.

examples.transfer: Which of two given pairs of numbers is farther apart?

mastery.evidence: Correctly finds the distance between two numbers up to 10 without an off-by-one error, twice.
